title: Inline SVG structure and accessible naming
learningObjectives: Explain inline svg structure and accessible naming and create scalable, accessible graphics or media markup.

understand.concept: Inline SVG uses an svg root element with a viewBox and child graphics elements. An accessible SVG image can use a title referenced by aria-labelledby, or an appropriate role and accessible name. Decorative SVG should be hidden from assistive technology when its meaning is already provided elsewhere.
understand.whyItMatters: An SVG needs an accessible name when it communicates information. Decorative graphics should not create repeated or confusing announcements.
understand.analogy: An inline SVG is a small drawing described inside the page; its accessible title is the label that explains the drawing to users who cannot see it.
understand.analogyLimit: The analogy is simplified; actual vector, bitmap, and accessibility behaviour follows the relevant graphics and browser specifications.

explain.narrative: The title provides the SVG's accessible name. A production chart may also need a longer description or equivalent data table.

examples.code: <svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' role='img' aria-labelledby='chart-title'><title id='chart-title'>Three rising bars</title><rect x='10' y='60' width='18' height='30' fill='#2a9d8f'/><rect x='40' y='40' width='18' height='50' fill='#2a9d8f'/><rect x='70' y='15' width='18' height='75' fill='#2a9d8f'/></svg>
examples.explanation: The title provides the SVG's accessible name. A production chart may also need a longer description or equivalent data table.
examples.expectedOutput: A browser-rendered SVG, canvas, or responsive image example.

practise.guidedTask: Create an informative SVG icon with a title and a decorative SVG hidden from assistive technology. Explain the difference.
practise.independentTask: Create a small graphic or responsive media example. Include accessible naming or equivalent text and test different display sizes.
hints: Keep important information available as HTML.
Use viewBox for SVG coordinate systems.
Test responsive source selection and image alternatives.

questions.prompt: Which attribute can connect an SVG image to its title element?
questions.explanation: aria-labelledby references the title element to provide the SVG's accessible name.

questions.prompt: What is a good accessibility practice for meaningful graphics?
options: Provide an accessible name or equivalent information
questions.answer: Provide an accessible name or equivalent information
questions.explanation: Meaningful visual information must also be available through accessible text or equivalent content.
